descriptions.d19d_texgen_scale_offset_8016c130: Build an identity 3x4 texture matrix in the render context (+968), set its S/T scale and S/T offsets, load it into the texture matrix for coordinate 'coord' (id from the const table 0x803a56b0) and generate that coordinate from 'source' through it (post matrix identity); then clear the owner's dirty word and set the coordinate state to 4.
